name: Phigros Bīngfēng Shìjiè
source:
Phigros is a rhythm game with rich playability and extremely high design limits (2D drop in any direction, direction mainly depends on the judgment line). Initially, downloads were posted within social media groups, but now players can log in and save on TapTap.
* Glaciaxion World * is the title of the 1st chapter, while Phigros GW is a doujin VN game developed by its fan creators based on this worldview.
